status: RF1–RF4 accepted as visual reference directions, without automatic approval of all biological or lore proposals.

references.title: Lampkeeper · leaf-limpet form
references.description: The selected low oval Lampkeeper becomes a single-species reference, preserving its scalloped soft mantle and warm central light. The underside and movement studies propose how it crawls; its later adult form remains open.

references.title: Moltwalker · ridged walker
references.description: This reference develops the selected elevated ridged Moltwalker and its whole-shell moult. The angular carapace and long walking legs remain the chosen identity; the underside, leg count and clean shedding sequence are proposed anatomical clarifications.

references.title: Ploughback · combined selection
references.description: This combines the selected long, low Ploughback body and trowel snout with the overlapping scales from take 3. The scale coverage and joint clearances are developed here as proposals; it remains a wild pig-sized rooter with an ordinary tail.

references.title: Hooktail · fully furred tail
references.description: The selected spotted Hooktail keeps its broad head, webbed paws and grasping tail, now covered entirely in fur. These views propose the tail's relaxed and gripping shapes without changing the animal into a reptile or giving it an extra limb.
